name: John Smith
title: Frontend Developer
summary: Frontend developer with experience building responsive, accessible web applications using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern development workflows. Skilled at turning design concepts into clean user interfaces, organizing application data, and improving page performance. Passionate about creating practical tools that are easy to maintain, easy to use, and helpful to real communities.
